settingsDesc: Select text in chat or tasks and ask about it in place.
setAnswerStyleHint: Controls how much detail the answer carries; it never changes "answer in the question’s language"
setCustomPersonaHint: Appended after the style directive and sent with every question; at most {n} characters
setCustomPersonaPlaceholder: e.g. cite verifiable sources; do not use tables
locateHint: Jump back to the passage on the page and highlight it
locateNotFound: The source text changed or is not in the current view
locateUnsupported: This environment cannot locate text (no page text nodes reachable)
exportFailed: Export failed: the browser refused the download
insertHint: Put this rewrite into the main-chat composer (sent messages stay untouched)
insertDone: Inserted into the composer — press Enter to send
insertStale: The composer changed; the insert did not apply — try again
insertFailed: Insert failed — copy the answer manually
setFollowUpsHint: The model ends each answer with a <followups> block of 2–3 next questions, rendered as clickable chips (no extra request)
setAutoExpandOnDone: Expand the card when the answer finishes
setAutoExpandOnDoneHint: On: the answer appears in the card the moment it settles. Off: the one-line capsule stays until you click it
errorReadonlyUnavailableBody: The side answer is set to read-only (sideTools: readonly), but this host exposes no read-only carrier (preset or tool filter), so the answer was refused to keep the workspace untouched. Switch the side tool policy to "inherit" in settings.
setReadonlyBlocked: ⚠ This host exposes no read-only carrier right now: keeping "read-only" refuses every run. Switch to "inherit", or set a preset this host honours below.
errorNoOriginBody: The write is missing its Origin header: pages send one automatically, scripts must declare it; on the desktop, sign in to DSH again and retry
errorDesktopOriginBody: The request came from the desktop shell page (dsh-app://app) but the host session did not validate: sign in to DSH again and retry
errorUntrustedHostBody: The Host is outside the trusted range: use http://127.0.0.1:<port> or add the address to trustedHosts
errorForeignOriginBody: The referring page is a different origin: the Origin host:port must match Host exactly
errorOpaqueOriginBody: The referring page has an opaque origin (Origin: null — sandboxed iframe / file:// / data:), refused as cross-site
errorCrossSiteBody: Cross-site request refused (the browser marked Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site)
errorMissingMarkerBody: The write is missing the x-sidecard-ask: 1 header (the page adds it automatically; scripts must declare it)
errorStarttlsMissingBody: The SMTP server never advertised STARTTLS, so nothing was sent — that keeps the credential off a cleartext socket. For a local plaintext relay, set feedbackSmtpStarttls: false in the config file, or append ?starttls=0 to the DSH_SIDECARD_SMTP_URL address.
copyInsecureHint: This address is not a secure context (plain http), so the browser hides the clipboard API: the text is selected — press Ctrl+C
